title: Cleaning and Damage Fees Evidence Standard: Core Photo Count by Photo Subjects
content:
**Clause.** The core photo count of a Cleaning and Damage Fees approval photo set is worked out from the photo subjects the level held requires: a level that requires a photo of each affected surface takes a close-up and an in-context photo of every seat row of the reported vehicle, that is the per-row photo pair for each seat row (three seat rows for Wayfare XL and Wayfare Black SUV, two for any other ride option), and its minimum photo count is not used; a level that requires close-up and in-context photos of the affected area takes its minimum photo count plus one overview photo of each passenger row, the seat rows behind the driver's row of the reported vehicle; any other level takes its minimum photo count.

The core photo count is the count the level held contributes to the approval photo set of a report under review. The per-row photo pair is 2 photos, and the overview is 1 photo for each passenger row. The ride option is the one on the trip record in Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares).

## Seat rows of the reported vehicle

| Ride option | Seat rows | Passenger rows (behind the driver's row) |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare XL or Wayfare Black SUV | 3 | 2 |
| any other ride option | 2 | 1 |

## The levels and their core photo count

| Fee level | Photo subjects the level requires | Minimum photo count | Core photo count, three-row vehicle | Core photo count, two-row vehicle |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cleaning Fee Level 1 (Minor) | close-up of the affected area | 2 | 2 (minimum) | 2 (minimum) |
| Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) | close-up of the affected area; affected area in context | 3 | 3 plus 2 overviews, that is 5 | 3 plus 1 overview, that is 4 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) | close-up of the affected area; affected area in context | 3 | 3 plus 2 overviews, that is 5 | 3 plus 1 overview, that is 4 |
| Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) | close-up of the affected area; affected area in context; each affected surface | 4 | 2 for each of 3 rows, that is 6 | 2 for each of 2 rows, that is 4 |
| Damage Fee (Interior Repair) | close-up of the damaged component; damaged component in context | 3 | 3 (minimum) | 3 (minimum) |
| Damage Fee (Exterior Repair) | close-up of the damaged component; damaged component in context; vehicle plate | 4 | 4 (minimum) | 4 (minimum) |

The damage levels require photos of the damaged component in context, not of the affected area in context, so their core photo count is their minimum photo count. Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) requires each affected surface, so its core is built per seat row and its minimum photo count of 4 is not used.

## Worked cores (hypothetical reports)

- Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) on a Wayfare Black SUV trip: minimum 3 plus one overview for each of 2 passenger rows, that is 5.
- Cleaning Fee Level 2 (Moderate) on a Wayfare Standard trip: minimum 3 plus 1 overview, that is 4.
- Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) on a Wayfare Comfort trip: 2 photos for each of 2 seat rows, that is 4.
